scripts.sync-data: node -e 'const fs=require("fs"); const path=require("path"); fs.mkdirSync(path.resolve("web/public/data"), {recursive: true}); fs.cpSync(path.resolve("data/dist"), path.resolve("web/public/data/dist"), {recursive: true, force: true}); if (fs.existsSync("data/geojson")) fs.cpSync(path.resolve("data/geojson"), path.resolve("web/public/data/geojson"), {recursive: true, force: true});'
scripts.dev: bash script/setup-native.sh && NODE_PATH=/root/.local/share/native-node-modules:/tmp/opencode/native node node_modules/next/dist/bin/next dev web --webpack
scripts.build: bash script/setup-native.sh && NODE_PATH=/root/.local/share/native-node-modules:/tmp/opencode/native node node_modules/next/dist/bin/next build web --webpack
scripts.start: bash script/setup-native.sh && NODE_PATH=/root/.local/share/native-node-modules:/tmp/opencode/native node node_modules/next/dist/bin/next start web
